title: Global leaderboard for fastest simulated car times
description: Spun off during 0003 (web front-end) planning, 2026-06-02. A shared, opt-in leaderboard of the fastest simulated race times so kids can compete (beat the pack record). Architecture: simulator stays 100% client-side (Pyodide); only the leaderboard talks to the network, via a free managed backend (e.g. Supabase/Firebase free tier) or a free-tier serverless function + KV store, with the static site hosted free (GitHub Pages / Cloudflare Pages / Netlify). CENTRAL OPEN QUESTION for its planning: this collides with the profile's hard constraints ('no network, no accounts, no data collection - safe for children') and US COPPA rules for under-13s. Must be designed safely: no real names/emails/accounts; optional anonymous car-nickname only; local 'personal best' by default with global submission as a deliberate opt-in; clearable; minimal-to-no PII. Profile will need an update to reflect a (leaderboard-only) network boundary. AGE CROSS-NOTE (added 2026-06-02 from 0003): 0003 reconciled the audience to 12-17 but skewed to the YOUNGER end (~12), so a large share of users are UNDER 13 - which makes the COPPA/verifiable-parental-consent question for any networked submission MORE acute, not less. Reinforces the no-PII / anonymous-nickname / local-personal-best-by-default stance above; revisit if the audience floor ever moves. Status: placeholder; user will iterate on it in a later session.
